source: CVPR2025 main paper and supplementary material
declared_component_choices: Integer round of effective multinomial count S_k*T in approximate Eq.5, not claimed exact.
Reuse DiT-S official six-head blocks and AdaLN-zero.
Single linear row/column embeddings and output projections; two-layer appearance MLP.
Pointwise linear fusion of concatenated row/column outputs.
Fixed one-dimensional sinusoidal positions over H+W ordered slices.
Softmax over 2H values per vertical slice to enforce the stated simplex.
must_resolve_before_claiming_author_equi: Exact DDETR checkpoint/backbone and task pretraining identity not supplied.
Appearance feature pooling and train proposal matching/sampling are unspecified.
Eq.6 is a likelihood over complete previous-slice candidates, not a 2H image-valued target. The paper does not specify how it is represented for the stated MSE loss.
Do not silently replace posterior MSE by epsilon, clean-image, or sampled-previous-state MSE.
V-COCO 24-action description does not define dual obj/instr output or missing-role serialization.
Ranked AP score construction, epochs and LR schedule remain unspecified.
mathematical_caveats: Supplement 5.1 extracts marginals, but their outer product does not generally reconstruct an arbitrary normalized joint slice.
Supplement Eq.19 equates forward and reverse conditionals without the required marginal ratio. Code does not assume that equality.
full_training_started_definition: Complete author-equivalent paper recipe; remains false, independent reconstruction is separate.

independent_reconstruction.approved_difference: Real multinomial trajectories and sampled previous-state regression with official generic DDETR-R50, fully disclosed; not the underspecified posterior-density MSE.
independent_reconstruction.optimizer: AdamW, lr1e-4, weight_decay1e-4, fixed constant schedule, FP32
independent_reconstruction.evaluation_plan: Fixed epoch30 checkpoint, all4946 test images, original V-COCO evaluator S1/S2 including/omitting point and per-role AP.
independent_reconstruction.benchmark_fairness_caveat: Generic COCO detector pretraining image overlap with V-COCO test is not yet audited; not a matched-detector or author-equivalent comparison.

closed_loop_repair.stop_reason: User declined the approximately29-hour repair training; not mandatory for the paper.
closed_loop_repair.restart_policy: Do not resume or launch another HOI-IDiff reconstruction without explicit user approval.
closed_loop_repair.change: M complete Eq4 forward trajectories, all50 model-owned reverse steps, per-step sampled-state MSE; explicitly truncated one-step gradients and one/M inference-prior endpoint
